_status: ONE-SHOT BTC15M PROFIT_LOCK_5 CAPACITY PROBE (Rung A). Can send a real order, so it is DISARMED by construction: this manifest sets no PMUS_Q1_LIVE/_ARM/_SESSION_ID and no PMUS_LIVE_MANDATE, so pmus_auth.armed() is False and pmus_live_mandate.load_mandate() returns no_mandate on a fresh service. One market, one window, one authorization spent on use. Runs once and exits; never restarts. The mandate/GuardedTransport boundary is the only monetary authority.
_live_service_note: The production service l5-live-probe-oneshot is configured through the Railway API and pinned to an exact commitSha, which supersedes watchPatterns: a push cannot deploy it at all. Its live watchPatterns are empty because this pattern -- pointing at a directory that does not exist -- caused deployment 65b1a618 to be SKIPPED, i.e. to skip its own build. The pattern is kept HERE so that applying this manifest to a fresh service is owner-gated by default; anyone applying it must clear the pattern for the first build, exactly as was done on 2026-09-28.
